shell.notice: AI-assisted, human-led. Scores compare your profile with each job's text and required skills; OpenAI writes the explanations from that evidence in your language. Nothing here verifies a skill or makes a hiring decision. Matching consent can be turned off in your privacy settings.

picker.label: Compare with a role
picker.none: No roles to compare yet. Save a job or add skills to your profile to see recommendations.

overview.title: Your potential, in perspective.
overview.description: Understand your strengths, see the evidence, and decide what comes next.
overview.snapshot: A snapshot of your profile. Strengths here reflect listed evidence, not independently verified proficiency.

stats.alignedCaption: Of {{count}} open roles in your market

overview.strengthsLead: Your skills in the open roles of your market
overview.barNote: Each bar shows how many of the {{count}} open roles in your market list that skill.
overview.noSkills: Add skills to your profile to see where they are in demand.
overview.contextText: These insights compare your profile with open roles in your market. They don't infer protected characteristics, assess your worth or make hiring decisions.
overview.matchesLead: Your best matches by score, with the evidence behind each.
overview.noMatches: No role reaches a Good match yet. Saved jobs and added skills change this.

gap.title: Know the gaps. Find your next step.
gap.description: A skill not listed is an open question, not a judgment about your potential.
gap.alignedCaption: Compared with this role's required skills
gap.missingCaption: Missing evidence, not a measure of ability
gap.experienceMet: Reported years meet the listed target
gap.heading: The gaps worth exploring
gap.headingLead: Prioritise role-relevant evidence. You don't need to tick every nice-to-have.
gap.none: No required skills are missing from your profile for this role. Role-specific depth, proficiency and team fit still need human review.
gap.sideBySide: See the evidence side by side
gap.addedText: You reviewed and added {{skill}} to your profile skills. Your CV is unchanged.

gap.tip: A practical way to build evidence

gap.removedAnnouncement: {{skill}} was removed from your profile skills.

review.title: Review {{skill}} before adding it
review.text: You control what belongs in your profile. Add this skill only if it accurately represents your experience. This does not edit your CV or certify proficiency.
review.confirm: I confirm that {{skill}} is part of my experience and want to add it to my profile.

plan.title: Your learning plan
plan.lead: A considered next step, not a new claim on your profile.
plan.empty: Add a skill from the gap analysis to start a plan. A plan item never becomes a profile skill on its own.
plan.note: Learning's "Suggested for you" uses these skills too. Finishing a course never adds a skill to your profile automatically.

source.title: Source evidence
source.description: The fields behind this comparison, from your profile and the job posting. Not independently verified.

improve.title: Give your experience a clearer voice.
improve.description: Small, thoughtful improvements. Every change reviewed and approved by you.
improve.badge: A profile you can stand behind
improve.heroCopy: Profile completeness counts the checklist areas you've provided, which you need to apply. It doesn't measure your ability.
improve.heading: Your next useful improvements
improve.headingLead: Suggestions, not requirements. Start where you can add meaningful evidence.

jobMatch.title: See the fit. Understand the evidence.
jobMatch.description: Skills, experience, preferences and open questions behind your match score.
jobMatch.fitLead: A starting point for your review, not a hiring decision.
jobMatch.locationNotMet: Outside the role's country or eligible countries
jobMatch.gapsLead: Missing evidence is not the same as missing capability.
jobMatch.nextText: Read the full brief, check the evidence, and decide whether this opportunity feels right.
jobMatch.contextText: A score summarises evidence; it can't explain a career decision. These insights don't verify your skills, infer protected characteristics or guarantee an interview.

why.title: A recommendation you can question.
why.description: Understand what was compared, what wasn't assessed, and why a role appears.
why.rank: Number {{rank}} in your For you list
why.heading: Why this opportunity is here
why.headingLead: Visible signals. No hidden claims about your ability.

details.orderedText: Your score blends how closely your profile, work history and live CV match the meaning of the job text with the share of required skills you list, as the platform's active matching policy weighs them. A different country or work mode can keep a score below Good. For you lists jobs at Good or above, best first.
details.orderedNote: OpenAI writes the explanations from this evidence; it never sets the score.
details.notAssessedText: Skill proficiency, achievements, interview performance, references and team fit are not verified. Photos and protected characteristics are never inputs.
details.changeText: Update your skills, experience, summary or live CV; scores are recomputed within a minute. Matching consent can be turned off in your privacy settings.

why.feedbackLead: Your answer is stored and counted for the platform's AI review; it does not train a model.

sources.profile: Your profile fields, preferences and live CV
sources.job: The job posting and its required skills

why.contextText: The score shows how closely the evidence lines up; it is not a probability of being hired.
